label: Logos & lettering
intent: Text that is the image. The letters must be correct, and the material has to sell them.

recipes.goal: A single logo or wordmark, rendered as a physical object.
recipes.when: Brand mark, app icon, signage mockup. One word or one symbol, nothing else.
recipes.text:
Create a {ratio} logo render of the word or mark "{text}".
LETTERING — spell it exactly as given. Draw every letterform deliberately and correctly; no invented or substituted characters. Set it in a single consistent style, evenly spaced, optically aligned.
COMPOSITION — {composition}, generous margin, the mark filling roughly 60 percent of the frame.
MATERIAL — the mark is a physical object made of {surface}, with believable thickness and edge highlights.
BACKGROUND — {background}, plain and untextured so the mark is the only subject.
LIGHTING — {lighting}.
RENDER — {render} with clean, straight edges and true circles.

image.accepts: an existing logo file or a photo of the mark
image.skeleton:
Use the supplied logo as the exact reference. Reproduce its letterforms, proportions and spacing faithfully — do not redraw, restyle, re-space or substitute any character.

Render that same mark as a {ratio} {render}: the logo realised as a physical object in {surface}, with believable thickness and edge highlights. {composition} with generous margin. {background}, lit with {lighting}. The mark must remain instantly recognisable as the one supplied.

negatives: no distorted or uneven letter spacing
recipes.example: Create a 1:1 logo render of the wordmark "NORTHWIND". LETTERING — spell it exactly, all caps, single weight, even spacing, optically aligned. COMPOSITION — centred hero, filling about 60 percent of the frame with generous margin. MATERIAL — the wordmark as a brushed metal object with real thickness and a bright top edge. BACKGROUND — flat deep teal. LIGHTING — even flat studio light. RENDER — 3D product render with clean straight edges and true circles.

recipes.goal: Type carrying a whole design, not just labelling it.
recipes.when: A campaign where the words are the art: a headline-led poster, a book cover, a social statement.
recipes.text:
Create a {ratio} type-led design where the words are the entire subject.
TEXT — the exact words "{text}". Spell them correctly, character for character. No other lettering appears anywhere in the frame.
TYPOGRAPHY — set in {type}, very large, the text treated as a solid graphic mass. Tighten the leading, let the type fill and bleed off the edges.
COMPOSITION — {composition}. The type's shape is the composition.
MATERIAL — give the letterforms a physical presence against {surface}, casting a real shadow, so they read as objects rather than pixels.
LIGHTING — {lighting}, raking across the letterforms so their depth is visible.
COLOUR — {grading}.
MOOD — {mood}.
recipes.example: Create a 3:4 type-led design where the words are the entire subject. TEXT — the exact words "NOT FOR EVERYONE". Spell them correctly; no other lettering appears anywhere. TYPOGRAPHY — high-contrast serif display, very large, set as three stacked lines that bleed off the left and right edges. COMPOSITION — centred hero, the block of type filling the canvas. MATERIAL — the letterforms cast in relief against a plaster wall, throwing a real shadow. LIGHTING — hard side sunlight raking across the letters so their depth is visible. COLOUR — high-contrast cinematic, near-black and bone white. MOOD — dramatic.

recipes.goal: A small identity system: mark, wordmark and application, on one sheet.
recipes.when: A brand needs more than one asset and you want them consistent in a single generation.
recipes.text:
Create a single {ratio} image: a brand identity sheet laid out as a 2 by 2 grid of four panels with thin grey dividers.
TOP LEFT — the primary wordmark "{text}" in {type}, black on {background}.
TOP RIGHT — the same wordmark reversed: white on a solid block of the brand colour.
BOTTOM LEFT — the mark applied to a physical object in {surface}, showing how it behaves on a real surface.
BOTTOM RIGHT — the wordmark at small size, as it would appear on stationery.
CONSISTENCY — the letterforms, spacing and proportions must be identical in all four panels. This is one brand shown four ways, not four designs.
LIGHTING — {lighting}. COLOUR — {grading}.
No captions, no panel numbers, no explanatory text of any kind.

image.skeleton:
Use the supplied logo as the exact reference. Its letterforms, spacing, mark geometry and colour must be reproduced faithfully in every panel — no redrawing or restyling.

Create a single {ratio} image: a brand identity sheet as a 2 by 2 grid with thin grey dividers. TOP LEFT — the mark in black on {background}. TOP RIGHT — the same mark reversed out of a solid brand-colour block. BOTTOM LEFT — the mark applied to an object in {surface}. BOTTOM RIGHT — the mark small, as on stationery. Identical letterforms and proportions in all four panels. {lighting}, {grading}. No captions or panel numbers.

recipes.example: Create a single 16:9 image: a brand identity sheet as a 2 by 2 grid with thin grey dividers, for a coffee roaster called "HALFLIGHT". TOP LEFT — the wordmark HALFLIGHT in bold geometric sans, black on seamless white. TOP RIGHT — the same wordmark reversed white out of a solid burnt-orange block. BOTTOM LEFT — the wordmark applied to a matte ceramic cup. BOTTOM RIGHT — the wordmark small, as it would sit on a business card. CONSISTENCY — identical letterforms and spacing in all four panels; one brand shown four ways. LIGHTING — even flat studio light. COLOUR — neutral and true. No captions, no panel numbers.
